units.title: FIELDS OF SOCIAL WORK - I
units.topics: Family & Child Welfare: Problems of family & children, institutional & non-institutional services. Correctional Social Work: Concept, causes of crime & delinquency, institutional & non-institutional services. Medical & Psychiatric Social Work: Concept of health, disease & hygiene, medical & psychiatric social work in hospital, role of medical & psychiatric social worker. Industrial Social Work: Concept of HRD & HRM, role & functions of HR manager & labour welfare officer.

units.title: FIELDS OF SOCIAL WORK - II
units.topics: Youth Welfare: Concept, needs & problems of youth, youth welfare services. Women Welfare: Situation of women in Indian society, gender issues, problems & welfare services for women. Welfare of the Differently Abled: Concept, causes, types & problems of differently abled, rehabilitation of differently abled. Gerontological Social Work: Concept, problems of elderly, services for elderly.

units.title: FIELDS OF SOCIAL WORK - III
units.topics: Urban Community Development: Concept of urban community, characteristics & problems of urban community, services for urban community development. Rural Community Development: Concept of rural community, characteristics & problems of rural community, services for rural community development. Tribal Community Development: Concept of tribal community, characteristics & problems of tribal community, services for tribal community development.

units.title: FIELDS OF SOCIAL WORK - IV
units.topics: Ecological / Environmental Social Work: Concept of ecology & environment, environmental issues & problems, role of social worker in environmental protection. Disaster Management: Concept, types & phases of disaster management, role of social worker in disaster management. Social Work in Conflict Resolution: Concept of conflict, causes & types of conflict, peace building & conflict resolution.
